questions.prompt: The Rosetta Stone was discovered during whose military campaign?
questions.fact: The expedition brought scholars as well as soldiers, and their survey created the modern study of ancient Egypt.

questions.prompt: Which particle is exchanged to produce the electromagnetic force?
questions.fact: It has no mass, which is why the force it carries reaches across the entire universe rather than fading out.

questions.prompt: Which sport is contested at the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield?
questions.fact: The venue seats under a thousand, making it far smaller than most sports would accept for a world final.

questions.prompt: Which game show features the phrase Is that your final answer?
options: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
questions.fact: The lighting and music were designed to intensify as the money rose, a format detail licensed along with the questions.

questions.prompt: Which US city is known as the Big Easy?
questions.fact: Much of it sits below sea level, protected by a levee system that failed catastrophically in 2005.

questions.prompt: Which term describes the repetition of vowel sounds within nearby words?
questions.fact: It binds a line together more subtly than rhyme, which is why it is common in free verse.

questions.prompt: Which storage medium held about 700 megabytes?
questions.fact: Its 74-minute capacity is often said to have been chosen so Beethoven's Ninth would fit on one disc.
